responsibility: Collects the public interface of the FR-V backend implementation in frv.cc. It declares target hooks, expanders, operand predicates, addressing and relocation helpers, prologue/epilogue and calling-convention routines, conditional-execution/if-conversion support, output helpers, FDPIC and TLS-related routines, and the frv_unspec relocation descriptor structure so the rest of GCC and generated md code can call into the FR-V target implementation.
